answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened to Timothy and what Paul sent him to do, beyond the companionship the summary already gives.

clauses.english: was circumcised by Paul because of the Jews of those parts
clauses.quote: took and circumcised him because of the Jews

clauses.english: was sent by Paul to the Thessalonians to establish and comfort them in their faith
clauses.quote: sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God

clauses.english: was asked by Paul to stay at Ephesus and charge some to teach no other doctrine
clauses.quote: I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus

doubts: ACT 16:1 names him as a disciple with a Greek father, which is already in the summary or the disambiguation, so it is not used as a clause.
Further sendings (to Macedonia, to Corinth) and his release in HEB 13:23 were left out to keep the line short.
